subject: Request: short interim access stipend while PO in flight
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@luminexhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Klein <jared.klein@luminexhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short runway request — PO and insurance verification in progress

Hi Michael,

Quick update from our side: legal and procurement are tied up with an insurance verification for our vendor onboarding — the PO is in review but it looks like it won't clear until next week. We're mid-demo and the team needs to keep experiments running for the clinical pilot.

Can Redwood provide a short interim access stipend or extend the demo window by ~7 days while the PO is routed? We can send a PO draft and the insurance confirmation once they finalize — we expect both within 3 business days.

Appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Program Lead, Clinical Integrations
Luminex Health
sofia@luminexhealth.com

Attachments: none
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@luminexhealth.com>
Cc: Jared Klein <jared.klein@luminexhealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short runway request — PO and insurance verification in progress

Hi Sofia — thanks for the heads-up and for outlining the timeline.

We can keep your sandbox live while procurement finishes the PO, and I can provision an interim access stipend to prevent the demo from stalling. Proposed terms:
- 15,000 token sandbox credit (one-time top-up) valid for 10 days from provisioning OR
- alternatively, a 7-day demo extension if you prefer to keep the token balance as-is.

Condition: we need a PO draft or confirmation email from procurement within 5 business days so we can reconcile for billing once the order clears. If the PO doesn't arrive in that window we'll pause the extra tokens.

I'm attaching a short SOW and a sample PO format to make procurement's life easier. If that looks good I will provision the stipend today. Camila, looping you for onboarding support and to note the temporary credit in the account. Rishi — tagging you for approval on the 15k figure (this is a one-off bridge).

Sincerely,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: SOW_Luminex_v0.9.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short runway request — PO and insurance verification in progress

Michael — go ahead and provision 15k tokens for Luminex. Please log this as a 'bridge stipend' in HubSpot and tag DL-78392 so finance has the note.
Also add a brief internal comment: 'Stipend conditioned on PO draft within 5 business days; auto-recap if PO not received.'

Camila — please prioritize the onboarding check-in and confirm we've not tied any production data retention policies to the demo instance (customer is in clinical workflows).

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales, MidMarket

From: Jared Klein <jared.klein@luminexhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@luminexhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short runway request — PO and insurance verification in progress

Michael/Camila — thank you, that solution works for us. We'll send a PO draft and the vendor insurance confirmation by EOD Tuesday (no later than 2028-03-19). Please proceed with the 15k token stipend.

Sofia will follow up with the procurement contact and copy us over the draft. Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will keep our internal stakeholders moving while legal finishes the review.

Best,
Jared Klein
Director, Strategic Ops
Luminex Health
Phone: (617) 555-2248

Attachments: Luminex_PO_draft.pdf (will attach when ready)
